title: Perp funding and liquidation reversal
thesis: Crypto perpetual markets may mean-revert after crowded liquidation events when funding is extended and price stabilizes near mark/index divergence extremes.
market_intuition: Liquidation spikes with stretched funding can mark short-term exhaustion if price stops making new lows/highs after forced flow clears.
entry_idea: Enter opposite the liquidation impulse after stabilization and mark/index divergence contraction.
exit_idea: Exit at mean reversion target, stop beyond liquidation extreme, or funding window close.
risk_assumption: Volatility-adjusted stop with max loss cap per event.
cost_slippage_assumption: Include taker fees, spread, and additional slippage during liquidation windows.
data_source: OHLCV, mark/index, funding, open interest, and liquidation feeds.
disproof_condition: Reject if edge cannot survive delayed entries or if liquidation data is unavailable for most events.

clarification_answers.q_event_threshold: Start with top decile liquidation notional by symbol.
clarification_answers.q_direction: Test both long and short exhaustion separately.
